title: Melbourne Solar Opportunity Mapping
author: Jawaharsriraam Sathya Rajendran, Sujay Narayana
description: This analysis evaluates solar energy installation potential across Melbourne's building infrastructure by combining geospatial building footprint data with solar irradiance measurements. The project calculates usable roof areas, estimates system capacities, projects energy generation, analyzes economic viability through cost-benefit analysis, and assesses environmental impact. Using a multi-factor scoring algorithm, it prioritizes buildings for solar installation based on technical feasibility, financial returns, and carbon reduction potential.
